# Local generic QFT family study

The [first source](attempt-01/transform.qli) is an informed local executable
translation candidate for the canonical QFT family. It adapts the pinned,
Apache-2.0 [Qualtran translation](../../../../corpus/sized/qualtran_qft/fourier.qli)
with preserved Google attribution. [Context](context.md) and
[identity](identity-before.json) were frozen before any source check.

The [session](session.json) appends real text/JSON observations without editing
first source bytes. This does not expose std::transform or establish a new
semantic guarantee. Native .qft width zero is not requested; only widths 0–3
are permitted in this study. Results will be documented separately after capture.
